findings.title: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
findings.description: The remote host is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability in Log4j. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this via crafted JNDI lookups, gaining full control of the application server. Affected component: log4j-core <= 2.14.1.

findings.title: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
findings.description: Duplicate re-scan entry: same CVE + PluginID + asset + port. The correlation engine must update last_seen instead of creating a duplicate record.

findings.title: Citrix ADC/Gateway Unauthenticated RCE
findings.description: Citrix ADC and Citrix Gateway are affected by a code injection vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution.

findings.title: Microsoft Exchange Server ProxyLogon RCE
findings.description: A remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server allows an unauthenticated attacker to run arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges.

findings.title: Spring Framework SpEL Injection (Spring4Shell)
findings.description: Spring Framework versions prior to 5.3.18 / 5.2.20 allow RCE when binding parameters to an object via crafted GET/POST requests.

findings.title: OpenSSL Heartbeat Information Disclosure (Heartbleed)
findings.description: OpenSSL 1.0.1 through 1.0.1f contains a flaw in the Heartbeat extension allowing memory disclosure of up to 64KB per request.

findings.title: SMBv1 Protocol Enabled (MS17-010)
findings.description: SMBv1 is enabled on the remote host, exposing it to EternalBlue-style exploits. Disable SMBv1 and apply KB4012212.

findings.title: TLS 1.0 Protocol Insecure Usage
findings.description: The remote service accepts TLS 1.0 connections. The deprecated protocol lacks modern cryptographic strength; migrate to TLS 1.2/1.3.

findings.title: Weak Domain Password Policy
findings.description: The domain password policy does not enforce minimum length, complexity or account lockout thresholds, increasing brute-force risk.

findings.title: Unsupported Java 8 Runtime Installed
findings.description: End-of-life Java 8 build deployed with known security defects and no vendor patch support.

findings.title: Service Accounts Running with Domain Admin Privileges
findings.description: Multiple Windows services are configured to run under accounts with Domain Admin membership; decompose to least privilege.

findings.title: Expired TLS Certificate on Production Gateway
findings.description: The TLS certificate for the production gateway has expired; renew immediately before user-facing availability is degraded.

findings.title: SNMP Service Uses Public Community String
findings.description: SNMP is configured with the default 'public' community string, allowing unauthenticated device enumeration.

findings.title: Unrestricted Network Shares (SMB)
findings.description: Administrative shares are exposed without explicit restriction across the LAN; restrict sharing to authorized subnets.
